senses.gloss: f. (מָזַג) mixing the wine, offering drink.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:1">Sabb. VIII, 1</cite> <he>כדי מְזִיגַת הכוס</he> as much wine as is required for a cup (of benediction) to be mixed with water.
<cite ref="Ketubot 61a">Keth. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ הכוס</he> offering the wine cup (by the wife).
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 1:2">Tosef. Sot. I, 2</cite> <he>כדי מ׳ הכוס</he> as much time as is required for preparing a cup of wine; Y. ib. I, 16ᶜ bot.; Bab.
